name: Nuraniah Learning Center / NLC
tagline: A comprehensive mobile platform to monitor student Quran learning progress, tahsin, tahfidz, and Islamic school administration.
tagline:id: Platform monitoring perkembangan santri, tahsin, tahfidz, dan administrasi lembaga pendidikan.

features.title: Digital Attendance
features.description: Real time daily student attendance verified by teachers.
features.description:id: Pencatatan kehadiran harian santri real time terverifikasi ustadz.

features.title: Tahsin & Mutabaah Tracker
features.description: Historical records of lesson submissions, volumes, and Quran memorization achievements.
features.description:id: Riwayat setoran dars, jilid, dan capaian hafalan Al Qur'an.

features.title: Transparent Tuition & Invoices
features.description: Easy access to invoice details, donation history, and tuition payment status.
features.description:id: Akses mudah ke rincian invoice, riwayat infak, dan status iuran.

features.title: Instant Notifications
features.description: Real time notifications for attendance, announcements, and student evaluations sent to parents.
features.description:id: Pemberitahuan instan kehadiran dan evaluasi belajar ke orang tua.

name: OtoTrack ~ Workshop & Live Service Tracker
tagline: Modern multi branch automotive workshop ERP platform with real time live vehicle service tracking for customers and mechanics.
tagline:id: Platform modern manajemen bengkel otomotif multi cabang & pelacakan status servis kendaraan secara real time.

features.title: Real Time Live Service Tracking
features.description: Vehicle owners can track each stage of repair and maintenance progress from anywhere.
features.description:id: Pelanggan dapat memantau setiap tahap pengerjaan kendaraan dari mana saja.

features.title: Digital Work Order & Photo Inspection
features.description: Photo documentation of vehicle conditions before and after service with customer approval.
features.description:id: Dokumentasi foto fisik kondisi kendaraan sebelum dan sesudah diservis.

features.title: Multi Branch & Spare Parts Inventory
features.description: Centralized spare parts stock control, cross branch transfers, and mechanic assignment.
features.description:id: Kontrol gudang sparepart, mutasi antar cabang, dan manajemen mekanik.

features.title: Transparent Invoicing & Estimates
features.description: Detailed cost breakdown for labor and parts with automated digital billing invoices.
features.description:id: Rincian biaya jasa dan suku cadang jelas dengan cetak invoice otomatis.
